help_menu.title: 📚 **Yuki - Arts Registry**
help_menu.description: **Description** Yuki is an active presence with persistent memory, capable of moving between different functions and maintaining genuine encounters with visitors.
help_menu.roles_section: **Arts and Paths** Paths are the different ways Yuki can be present to offer specific services to visitors.
help_menu.behavior_section: **Presence Protocols** Configuration of Yuki's interaction routines. Exclusive for Administrators.
help_menu.shortcuts_section: **Quick Access** Configure up to 5 shortcut buttons in the Canvas home for immediate access to your favorite arts. Available in Settings > Shortcuts.

shortcuts_messages.title: Quick Access Configuration
shortcuts_messages.settings_description: Configure quick access buttons on Canvas home
shortcuts_messages.configure_shortcut: Configure Shortcut {shortcut_id} - Select a role or subrole:

help_menu.tips_section: **Suggestions** -You can ask me about my own protocols: 'how does the dice module work?' -Each path has its own rhythm and requires its own listening.

canvas_home_messages.title: ⛩️ Yuki's Hall
canvas_home_messages.description: Access each part of the hall from here to access the services.
canvas_home_messages.dm_default_server_message: *Message received in private channel. Responding from the first available room.*

roles_view_messages.title: 🪭 Arts and Paths 🪭
roles_view_messages.description: 🌸 Explore the different ways Yuki can be present and be of use.
roles_view_messages.no_roles_active: 🌸 **THE HALL IS IN SILENCE** No specialized path is active at this moment. Request an administrator to activate one of the available services via `!canvas setup`. **Available paths:** • 📡 News Watcher - News observation • 💎 Treasure Hunter - Item analysis • 🎭 Trickster - Chance and probability • 💰 Banker - Resource management • 🎵 MC - Music
roles_view_messages.frequency_help: 📝 Adjust cadence: Use `!canvas` → Configuration → Frequency (range: 1 to 168 hours) Example: Set frequency to 2 hours to receive updates every 2 hours.
roles_view_messages.music_help: 🎵 **Music** - `!mc play <name>` / `!mc queue` | `!mc help` to check the full repertoire.

conversation.title: 💬  **Yuki - Conversation Presence**
conversation.description: **Description:** -Yuki will respond to direct messages and mentions. -Maintains memory of past conversations that were meaningful. -Will react to certain specific terms according to active paths. In the taboo module, words that trigger particular responses are configured.

greetings.title: 👋  **Yuki - Reception**
greetings.description: **Description:** -Yuki greets visitors when they connect. -Maintains recognition for 5 min before considering the visitor absent.

welcome.title: 🍵  **Yuki - Welcome**
welcome.description: **Description:** -Yuki welcomes new visitors who arrive at the room.

taboo.title: 🚫  **Yuki - Attention Touches**
taboo.description: **How it works:** -Configure words or expressions that trigger a discourteous response from Yuki. -Taboo words can be added or removed.
